smtlib:
(set-logic QF_UF)
(declare-sort Word 0)
(declare-fun cat (Word Word) Word)
(declare-fun f (Word) Word)
(declare-const u Word)
(declare-const v Word)
(declare-const w Word)
(assert (= (cat u (cat v w)) (cat (cat u v) w)))
(assert (= (f (cat u (f (cat v w)))) (f (cat u (cat v w)))))
(assert (= (f (cat (f (cat u v)) w)) (f (cat (cat u v) w))))
(assert (not (= (f (cat u (f (cat v w)))) (f (cat (f (cat u v)) w)))))
(check-sat)
